identity.tacticalRole: Highly predictable objective fixation that players can redirect through positioning, disguise, and literal wording.

identity.fantasy: The lair pumps grave gas into its dead until the remains become biological pressure mines.
identity.tacticalRole: Short-lived anchored hazards that threaten routes but reward target selection, damage-type choice, and object interaction.

identity.signature: The monster retreats from bright exposure and disappears only when isolated in darkness.

identity.fantasy: A hungry spirit that borrows the dead as temporary flesh while keeping its senses fixed on both worlds.
identity.tacticalRole: Corpse-dependent defensive posture with a destructible environmental anchor.
identity.signature: It enters a corpse to gain half cover and immovability until the body is disturbed.

identity.fantasy: A hungry spirit that crosses solid matter while its cold shape bleeds through the exit surface.
identity.tacticalRole: Barrier bypass pattern with a readable exit point that supports held actions and route denial.
identity.signature: Its intended exit becomes visible before it emerges from solid matter.

identity.fantasy: A hungry spirit peels its human outline open and exposes a grave-fed shape that should not fit inside it.
identity.tacticalRole: Recharge visual reveal that opens space and creates a brief fear window without permanent aging effects.
identity.signature: A cone of witnesses sees the true corpse-eater and becomes immune after resisting the revelation.

identity.fantasy: A starving spirit that becomes visibly solid and swollen after devouring a body.
identity.tacticalRole: Corpse-powered recovery phase whose temporary durability also exposes the monster and changes its movement.
identity.signature: One corpse grants temporary hit points and speed, but removes invisibility and disguise until the borrowed flesh is stripped away.

identity.fantasy: A spirit wearing a dead person's voice and manners as a rehearsed social costume.
identity.tacticalRole: Investigation-facing infiltration trait with explicit evidence-based exposure rules.
identity.signature: The disguise is convincing until someone tests a memory the corpse could not provide.

identity.fantasy: An undead impostor that is not merely disguised but psychologically dependent on the mortal life it invented.
identity.tacticalRole: Investigation-earned control window tied to public exposure and a defined identity anchor.
identity.signature: Two witnesses and concrete evidence can collapse the persona and force the monster back toward its anchor.

identity.fantasy: A calculating spirit that changes footwork according to whether it must close, escape, or disappear.
identity.tacticalRole: Three-mode movement pattern that gives the GM a clear positional choice without granting unrestricted Cunning Action.
identity.signature: It chooses Rush, Slip, or Stalk according to the current battlefield state.

identity.tacticalRole: Ambush premise reversal with an inspection procedure and a bounded reaction-denial window.
identity.signature: The false corpse can be identified before it rises; otherwise its reveal grants one half-speed reposition without Opportunity Attacks.

identity.fantasy: The neglected dead use grave goods and stolen remains to demand recognition from anyone nearby.
identity.tacticalRole: Short-lived pull zone with an explicit ritual answer that rewards interacting with the fiction rather than only dealing damage.
identity.signature: A respectful offering or restoration of the disturbed grave ends the spectral pull immediately.

identity.tacticalRole: Anchor-centered target priority plus baitable reaction movement.
identity.signature: Threatening the Brood immediately pulls the guardian toward the intruder, even into a trap.

identity.signature: Players can destroy the eggs to stop hatching, but the last destroyed egg releases the carrier from its burden.

identity.signature: It cannot be knocked prone while clinging, but forced detachment makes it fall.

identity.fantasy: A corpse sealed in funerary wax: preserved against cold and rot, but unable to repair itself and vulnerable to heat.
identity.tacticalRole: Persistent resistance chassis with a fire-based suppression window and a built-in no-healing cost.
identity.signature: Fire temporarily melts away its resistances, while the wax body can never regain hit points.

identity.tacticalRole: Sight-line movement puzzle that turns group awareness and illumination into direct positional control.
identity.signature: It moves only while every conscious hostile observer has lost line of sight.

identity.fantasy: A funeral mask that cracks at bloodied and reforms into a new public identity for the second phase.
identity.tacticalRole: Visible bloodied choice between escape, accusation, or recovery, each with a different player response.
identity.signature: The changed face announces exactly which second-phase benefit is active and can be removed through interaction.

identity.fantasy: A false face that becomes glossy, translucent, and easy to tear when heated.
identity.tacticalRole: Two-step damage-type combo that opens Advantage and suppresses identity-based escape.
identity.signature: Fire softens the wax; the next hit tears the mask and locks out Reactions.

identity.fantasy: A preserved face that refuses to die anonymously and copies its final witnesses into the last expression.
identity.tacticalRole: Sight-based death control with a deliberate reaction trade and a destructible pre-death anchor.
identity.signature: The dying mask selects witnesses, who can avert their gaze or risk fear and reaction loss.

identity.fantasy: A corpse surrounded by a visible layer of grave vapor that makes every approach physically revolting.
identity.tacticalRole: Breathing-based proximity pressure that separates melee attackers from safer positions.
identity.signature: Creatures that begin their turn inside the visible vapor risk being poisoned, then become immune after resisting it.

identity.fantasy: A spider whose apparent body is only a shell around hundreds of moving young.
identity.tacticalRole: Once-per-encounter bloodied reveal that creates a short fear window but offers an explicit reaction-based escape.
identity.signature: Witnesses can choose not to look, sacrificing sight of the monster to avoid the brood revelation.
